t: You're standing in the Queen Elizabeth II Great Court, the covered central quadrangle of the British Museum. It was redeveloped in the late 1990s by Foster and Partners, working from a 1970s design by Colin St John Wilson. Queen Elizabeth II opened the court in 2000, and it carries her name. She was queen from 1952 until 2022, and her reign of more than seventy years is the longest of any British monarch.
